_readme: Captured price fixtures for WINDFALL_FIXTURES=1 replay mode.
These stand in for live Duffel and hotel re-query so the pipeline runs
end-to-end, deterministically, with no API keys. Reading them is a read of
a local file, which is squarely inside the penyisihan storage rule; nothing
The live path stays fully functional and is the default. Fixture mode is a
reproducibility measure for judging day, and the UI labels it visibly --
'cached for reliability' must never quietly become 'faked'.
Rung totals are FULL CART totals (flight + hotel), not hotel-only, because
delta_k is measured against the whole cart. The flight component is
identical across every rung by construction: the ladder never touches the
flight, so a Hold Order stays valid.

cart-wf-01.note: Gate opens on both axes. Re-price and the lateral swap fall short; one star down clears tau.  tau=5%; reprice -2.1%, lateral -3.8%, tier_down -11.2%.

cart-wf-02.note: Gate opens on both axes. Re-price and the lateral swap fall short; one star down clears tau.  tau=10%; reprice -3.4%, lateral -7.2%, tier_down -12.6%.

cart-wf-03.note: Low campaign share. The gate must close on that axis even though the cart runs over usual spend.

cart-wf-04.note: Gate opens, no rung clears tau, so a different trip is proposed instead of a discount.  tau=5%; reprice -1.8%, lateral -3.0%, tier_down -4.1%.

cart-wf-05.note: Gate opens on both axes. The same-star swap clears tau, so the ladder stops before any downgrade.  tau=10%; reprice -4.0%, lateral -10.8%, tier_down -13.5%.

cart-wf-06.note: Upstream failure path. The classifier completes; the searcher halts.

cart-wf-07.note: Gate opens on both axes. Re-price and the lateral swap fall short; one star down clears tau.  tau=5%; reprice -2.0%, lateral -3.5%, tier_down -8.7%.

cart-wf-08.note: Low campaign share. The gate must close on that axis even though the cart runs over usual spend.

cart-wf-09.note: Gate opens, no rung clears tau, so a different trip is proposed instead of a discount.  tau=10%; reprice -1.9%, lateral -5.0%, tier_down -8.1%.

cart-wf-10.note: Gate opens on both axes. Re-price and the lateral swap fall short; one star down clears tau.  tau=5%; reprice -2.0%, lateral -3.6%, tier_down -10.2%.

_timings_note: Captured wall-clock from a recorded live run, replayed in fixture mode. In live mode these are measured per request. Never synthesised from a hash of the cart id -- a duration the UI presents as real must be real.
